name: Israel Opportunity Energy Resources, LP.
summary: Israel Opportunity - Energy Resources, LP engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and gas properties. It also holds a portfolio of participating rights in various offshore and onshore oil assets in Israel and North America. In addition, Israel Opportunity  Oil and Gas Exploration Ltd serves as a general partner of the company. Israel Opportunity - Energy Resources, LP was founded in 2010 and is based in Ramat Gan, Israel.
